usageNote: be good with + 工具/技能，超实用句型！说某人玩某东西很溜就用这个，随意又地道～

examples.en: She's really good with bows and arrows—she hit the bullseye three times in a row!
examples.zh: 她弓箭真的很厉害——连续三次射中靶心！

examples.en: His grandfather taught him to be good with bows and arrows when he was just a child.
examples.zh: 他爷爷从他小时候就教他练箭术。
